messages:
Nina: Heads-up: SecureBridge onboarding handoff tomorrow 11am PT. Need alignment on SSO/SAML nameID, SCIM groups, BYOK workflow into our KMS, and marketplace listing copy. I'm drafting a one-pager. Who takes which item? :spiral_note_pad:

Diego: I can take SSO + SCIM mapping. Quick Q: do they want SCIM push only, or also SCIM pull from our side? They mentioned group sync for entitlement mapping. Also need SAML metadata (cert, entityID, ACS).

Priya: Security will lead BYOK/KMS and HSM checks. Requirements: partner must provide key wrapping public key (PEM) and attest HSM vendor + certs. We prefer RSA-OAEP-256 for wrapping, and AES-GCM for symmetric ops. If HSM not FIPS certified, list compensating controls.

Tom: Legal: embargo window? We'll need a joint announcement approval window and review of logo usage. Also check if partner wants pre-approval for quotes. I can prep the template NDA amendment for SOC2/Security Addendum.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Partnership announcement template at https://internal/marketing/partner_announce_v2 — fill in 'customer-highlight' and 'technical-integration' sections.

Nina: Proposed owners: Diego = SCIM/SSO, Priya = KMS/HSM, Tom = legal/embargo. Also need someone to draft marketplace blurb and a short tech README for the marketplace tile. @Diego can you start the README with auth flow diagram?

Diego: Yep. I'll sketch README with sequence: SAML -> SCIM group sync -> KMS envelope wrap -> tokens. Will add a minimal sequence diagram and sample SAML assertion. Need partner to confirm nameID format (transient vs persistent) and if they sign assertions with SHA-256.

Priya: Ops note: rotation policy must be supported. Partner key must allow re-wrapping without breaking existing tokens. We'll run a key rotation test in staging; need partner to provide a staging key and key-import instructions for their HSM.

Tom: Legal note: embargo date request must be at least 5 business days after final draft is submitted. Please route quotes to legal-marketing@redwood.ai for sign-off.

Diego: Sample SCIM curl for partner to sanity-check:
curl -X POST 'https://staging.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"userName":"alice","name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Lee"},"emails":[{"value":"alice@partner.com"}],"groups":[{"display":"eng","value":"eng-123"}]}'

Also request: support for SCIM patch for incremental updates.

Priya: For KMS/BYOK provisioning, here's the minimal checklist: partner PKCS#1/PKCS#8 public key, cert chain, allowed wrap algos, HSM vendor + firmware version, attestation report. We'll run a hatch test: import key in staging, wrap sample token, unwrap locally. ETA for security sign-off: 3 business days after artifacts received.

Nina: I'll collate artifacts under /projects/partners/securebridge and send an invite for tomorrow's call. Please post blockers in this thread before EOD. Also add any required compliance docs. Thanks! :thumbsup:
